clue.text: Remarkably gruff about pressure mounting

indicators.note: about means the word for gruff wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: gruff means surly
P is the physics symbol for pressure
mounting means rising

explanation.surface: Someone surly becomes strangely irritable as the pressure on them builds.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are adverbs saying something happened in an unexpected or striking way.

clue.text: Unwell below decks, finally at sea

indicators.note: in a down entry, below means this piece comes after the one above it
finally points to the closing letter of the word decks

parts.note: unwell means ailing

explanation.surface: A seasick passenger lies below decks feeling ill on a voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'below' places AILING under S, the last letter of 'decks'.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship out on the water under sail is travelling, so the boating activity matches being out on the ocean.

clue.text: Concerned with a relative's motives

parts.note: re means concerning or with regard to
a son is a relative, and the possessive gives the plural-looking form sons

explanation.surface: Someone asks about the motives behind a family member's actions.
explanation.definitionFit: Motives and grounds for action are synonyms, both meaning the causes behind behaviour.

clue.text: Drill catches in concrete

indicators.note: in means the word for catches is placed inside the word for concrete

parts.note: concrete in the sense of actual or tangible means real
catches, as in catches a sound, means hears

explanation.surface: A power drill gets stuck while boring into a concrete wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drill' and 'concrete' read as building work, but drill is a practice session and concrete is an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill is a practice run of a procedure, just like a run-through before a performance.

clue.text: Personnel removed from post affected

indicators.note: removed from tells us the letters are taken out of the run of words post affected

explanation.surface: Workers have been taken off their jobs, and the post is suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: Personnel and workforce are synonyms for the people employed by an organisation.

clue.text: Scoff inside shelter for most organised

indicators.note: inside means the word for scoff sits within the word for shelter

parts.note: a nest is a shelter for birds
scoff, as in eat greedily, means eat

explanation.surface: Eating inside a refuge is presented as the tidiest arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Superlative of a word meaning tidy and orderly, so it fits the most organised.

clue.text: Element illuminated with buzz holding current

parts.note: illuminated means lit

indicators.note: holding means the word for buzz contains the symbol for current

parts.note: a buzz is a hum
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A glowing, buzzing element carries an electric current, like a light bulb.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithium is a chemical element, the lightest metal, so it is an example of the defining word.

clue.text: Defiant bluster undermining cleric at broadcast

indicators.note: in a down entry, undermining means this piece sits beneath the other
broadcast means scattered, so the letters of cleric at are rearranged

parts.note: bluster means to rant

explanation.surface: A furious outburst damages a clergyman's reputation on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns CLERIC AT into RECALCIT; 'undermining' puts RANT under it.
explanation.definitionFit: Recalcitrant means stubbornly refusing to obey, so it is a synonym of defiant.

clue.text: Record one hit? Hard to produce commemoration

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record
one is the Roman numeral I
hit means tap
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A musician wonders whether releasing one hit single would be difficult, as a tribute.
explanation.definitionFit: An epitaph is an inscription on a tomb honouring the dead, a form of memorial.

clue.text: Plug fitter for electrical accessory

parts.note: a plug is an advert, shortened to ad
fitter in the sense of more suitable means apter

explanation.surface: An electrician fits plugs and other accessories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plug fitter' looks like a tradesman, but plug is an advertisement and fitter is a comparative adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: This device lets a plug of one kind fit a socket of another, a common electrical gadget.

clue.text: Enrolment of American soldier in support, helping

indicators.note: in means the soldier's letters go inside the word for support

parts.note: a rest is a support
GI is a US soldier
a helping or portion is a ration

explanation.surface: A US serviceman signs up and is helped through support.
explanation.definitionFit: Registration is the act of signing up, so it is a synonym of enrolment.

clue.text: Song embodying unending territory somewhere in the USA

indicators.note: embodying means the song's word holds the other piece within it

parts.note: an aria is a song in opera

indicators.note: unending means the word for territory loses its final letter

parts.note: a territory is a zone

explanation.surface: A song about endless land somewhere in America, like a cowboy ballad.
explanation.definitionFit: Arizona is one of the US states, so it is a place in America.

clue.text: Showing off curves, former wife caught in liaison

indicators.note: caught in means the ex is held inside the word for liaison

parts.note: a liaison, a brief affair, is a fling
a former wife is an ex

explanation.surface: A man's ex-wife flaunting her figure is spotted in an affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Bodybuilders bend their arms to show off muscle shape, so displaying curves this way fits the definition.

clue.text: Caught then time's in pens

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
time's read as times, long periods, gives ages

explanation.surface: A criminal is caught and then spends a long time in prison pens.
explanation.definitionFit: Pens and enclosures with bars for animals are synonyms, both meaning places to confine.

clue.text: Well satisfied by the compiler's empty excuses occasionally

parts.note: well, as an interjection, means so
satisfied, as of a need, means met
the compiler's is the setter speaking of himself, I am, shortened

indicators.note: empty means only the outer letters of excuses remain

explanation.surface: The setter admits being content with flimsy excuses now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Both adverbs mean now and then, at irregular intervals.

clue.text: Mother love in separation producing pleasure from pain

parts.note: ma is mother

indicators.note: in means the zero for love goes inside the word for separation

parts.note: a schism is a separation or split
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A mother's love during a family split brings both joy and suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: This term names taking enjoyment from being hurt, exactly the phrase given.

clue.text: Ravel's including unlimited brio for instruments

indicators.note: including means the word for ravels holds the other piece

parts.note: Ravel's read as ravels, meaning tangles

indicators.note: unlimited means brio loses its outer letters

explanation.surface: The composer Ravel's music features lively orchestral instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ravel' looks like the French composer, but it is the verb meaning tangle.
explanation.definitionFit: These are percussion instruments struck with a metal beater, found in orchestras.

clue.text: Breaks in rugby strip which is damaged outside

indicators.note: outside means the scrambled letters surround the rugby abbreviation
damaged means the letters of strip are reworked

parts.note: RU is short for Rugby Union

explanation.surface: A rugby kit gets torn and someone barges into the changing room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'which is damaged' turns STRIP into IRPTS, which goes 'outside' RU.
explanation.definitionFit: To irrupt is to burst into a place forcibly, so it means to break in.

clue.text: Tack over on jetty getting more nimble

indicators.note: over in a down entry means the word for tack is turned upside down

parts.note: a tack is a pin
a jetty is a pier

explanation.surface: A sailor tacks round on a jetty and gets quicker on their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Nippy means quick and agile, so the comparative means more nimble.

clue.text: One attempts to rake in extra readies initially

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the words to rake in extra readies

explanation.surface: Someone tries to bring in extra cash.
explanation.walkthrough: Readies is British slang for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who tries hard is one who attempts things, the noun from the verb try.

clue.text: Providing force in truck lifting vehicles

indicators.note: lifting in a down entry means the whole assembled piece is read upwards
in means the condition word and force go inside the word for truck

parts.note: a truck is a cart
providing means if
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: Pressure is needed to raise a lorry carrying vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic is the collective term for vehicles moving on roads.

clue.text: Noble, not having a chance

indicators.note: not having means the letter for the word a is dropped from the word for noble

parts.note: noble, as in regal or majestic, means imperial

explanation.surface: An aristocrat lacks any opportunity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chance' is a verb here, meaning to risk.
explanation.definitionFit: To chance something is to put it at risk, the same as endangering it.

clue.text: Adult support facing very big fitting

parts.note: A is the film classification abbreviation for adult
a support is a prop
OS stands for outsize, very big

explanation.surface: An adult brace sits next to an oversized fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos means appropriate or relevant, so it is a synonym of fitting.

clue.text: Father seen with woman, ultimately she's seductive

parts.note: to sire is to father, and a sire is a father

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of woman

explanation.surface: A father is spotted with a woman who is quite alluring.
explanation.definitionFit: A siren is a temptress, after the mythical singers who lured sailors, so an alluring female.

clue.text: Mine's topical preparation

indicators.note: a preparation is something made up, so the letters of topical are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone claims a newsy item they prepared as their own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mine' looks like the possessive pronoun; it is the noun for a pit.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a pit where fuel is dug out of the ground, a type of mine.

clue.text: Clue's 'Single by Queen, rockier'

parts.note: a clue is a tip, and the possessive gives tips
single, one, is I
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A quiz hint names a single by Queen, a band that rocks harder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rockier' suggests rock music, but it means less steady on one's feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone more drunk is unsteady and wobbly, so they are rockier on their feet.

clue.text: On fire after explosion, consuming new fire

indicators.note: consuming means the rearranged letters swallow the abbreviation for new
after an explosion things are scattered, so the letters of on fire are rearranged

explanation.surface: A building catches fire after a blast that engulfs everything new.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter reuses 'fire': once inside the anagram, once as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An inferno is a huge raging blaze, so it is a large instance of a fire.

clue.text: Stellar tail arcs incredibly around spinning moon

indicators.note: incredibly means the letters of tail arcs are wildly rearranged
spinning means the word moon is turned back to front

explanation.surface: A comet's tail sweeps arcs across the sky around a turning moon.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly, the rearranged letters from 'incredibly' go 'around' the turned moon, rather than being one shuffled pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Stellar can mean huge or exceptional, as can this word, and both also relate to stars.
